items.title: Noel Tata disputes Tata Sons board minutes, says Chandrasekaran's reappointment should be deleted from official records.
items.summary: The minutes misrepresented his objections and omitted mention of two key conditions agreed by board members, Noel Tata wrote. However, Tata Sons did not make the changes requested, and made a statutory filing about the reappointment.

items.title: US Markets Today: S&P, Nasdaq end higher as Anthropic IPO filing revives AI optimism; Tesla hits 3 month high
items.summary: US stocks ended higher as Anthropic's IPO filing rekindled interest in AI related investments and stocks. The S&P 500 gained 0.70% and the Nasdaq rose by 0.83% following this news. Investors are keenly observing Anthropic's filing and its implications for the booming AI sector. Major companies like Meta are also planning significant investments in AI infrastructure and data centers.

items.title: MakeMyTrip swings to $1.8 million profit in Q2 FY27 despite headwinds
items.summary: MakeMyTrip's gross bookings rose 20.9% in constant currency terms to $2.7 billion, while high airfares and capacity constraints continued to weigh on its air ticketing business.

items.title: Tokenisation offers common ledger for real-world assets, says Edul Patel
items.summary: Mudrex CEO Edul Patel says tokenisation could improve liquidity, transparency and access to real-world assets through a common digital ledger, but regulatory safeguards remain crucial.

items.title: Retail participation has been very strong in India, says Vikas Satija
items.summary: Shriram Wealth's Vikas Satija says long-term investors should not fear market volatility, while AI will reshape wealth management without replacing relationship managers.

items.title: Tata Motors completes Iveco acquisition to turbocharge global play
items.summary: The $4.5 billion deal will expand the Indian automaker’s global footprint and strengthens its presence across commercial vehicle segments.

items.title: Tata Motors' Iveco takeover bid clears 80 pc acceptance threshold
items.summary: Tata Motors’ bid for Iveco clears 80% threshold, reaches 87.8% acceptance on final day of offer.

items.title: Cotton shortage set to worsen as new deals drive export demand
items.summary: The impact of El Nino weather conditions could further hurt domestic production, expected to fall by 3.4% to a new low in the 2026-27 crop year ended September. Cotton imports hit a record high in 2025-26 to an estimated 7.1 million bales of 170 kilograms compared to last year's imports of 5.74 million bales. Prices have also risen more than 7% in the past month.

items.title: Anthropic halts AI training for over a month over security concerns as models breach testing systems ahead of IPO
items.summary: Anthropic pauses training of its next generation AI model for more than a month over security concerns, while four AI models access live external computer systems during testing. The company discloses the incidents in its IPO filing as it warns that training delays could affect revenue and leave it behind rivals.

items.title: India and US fine-tune trade pact after concluding most talks, says Piyush Goyal
items.summary: India and the United States have nearly finalized discussions regarding a proposed bilateral trade agreement. Commerce Minister Piyush Goyal mentioned that fine-tuning of the agreement is currently underway. This follows remarks from US Secretary of State Marco Rubio about a few remaining details. Initially, the US removed a penalty on Indian goods related to Russian oil purchases.

Pre-sales also rose to Rs 1,611 crore, showing continued demand for properties. The company made significant investments in business development, acquiring land in Borivali. items.title: FTA with India will be a game changer in supply chain management: EU ambassador to India
items.summary: EU ambassador to India Jean-Eric Paquet further said, "We are creating an economic space across India and the European internal market. That is what is being established, creating a long-term perspective and reliability for economic operators, which will obviously build on very significant trade already."

items.title: EU can learn from India on cutting regulatory burden, says Piyush Goyal as Dutch minister rules out CBAM rethink
items.summary: Piyush Goyal addressed the India-Netherlands Business Forum, highlighting India's deregulation efforts to reduce burdens on businesses. He asserted that the EU could learn from India's successful approach to regulatory matters. Dutch Minister Sjoerd Sjoerdsma acknowledged the importance of necessary regulations but emphasized the need to review those that hinder trade. He reiterated that climate and product safety…

items.title: Dalmia Bharat posts Rs 205 crore Q2 loss on exceptional hit
items.summary: Dalmia Bharat experienced a consolidated loss of Rs 205 crore in the September quarter of this year. This loss was due to an exceptional hit of Rs 339 crore related to asset impairment and employee separation. Sales volume rose by 3% year-on-year, while consolidated revenue increased by 4% to Rs 3,563 crore. However, EBITDA fell by 29% due to rising power and fuel costs, which increased by 22%.

items.title: Microsoft to offer buyouts to 60,000 employees in India, US, UK and Canada as it restructures workforce for AI
items.summary: Microsoft Corp. will offer buyouts to about 60,000 workers, part of the company’s efforts to trim costs and retool its workforce for the artificial intelligence era.

items.title: Paytm Q2FY27 net profit jumps 10-fold to ₹225 crore, revenue up 28 %
items.summary: One 97 Communications Ltd, the parent company that operates the brand Paytm, reported an over 10-fold rise in profit after tax to Rs 225 crore in the September quarter (Q2 FY27), from Rs 21 crore a year ago, on a reported basis, marking its sixth consecutive profitable quarter. Operating revenue rose 28 per cent YoY to Rs 2,648 crore, driven by sustained momentum across merchant and consumer businesses, expanded…

items.title: Nippon Life AMC shares: Last chance to buy for ₹9.50 interim dividend; record date, dividend yield
items.summary: Nippon Life India Asset Management set October 28, 2026, as the record date for its ₹9.50 interim dividend, with October 27 likely the last day to buy shares and qualify. September-quarter profit fell 6% to ₹324.4 crore, partly due to a SEBI settlement, while revenue rose 21%.

items.title: Noel Tata challenges Chandrasekaran's reappointment as Tata Sons chairman, seeks board meeting video
items.summary: Tata Trusts chairman Noel Tata has challenged N Chandrasekaran's reappointment as Tata Sons chairman, calling the resolution void over procedural concerns. Noel has also sought an unedited board meeting video.

items.title: Stock markets rebound after 4-day slump; Sensex jumps 483 points
items.summary: Sensex gained 483 points to close at 73,606.75, while Nifty rose 153 points to 22,753.20, ending a four-day losing streak as metal, telecom and healthcare stocks rallied.

items.title: Jio IPO falls short of record payday for bankers despite mega issue
items.summary: Jio Platforms is paying 19 banks about ₹196 crore in fees for its $3.1 billion IPO, just 0.65% of the issue size, as fierce competition squeezes investment banking earnings.

items.title: Goldman Sachs Kospi target cut: Why South Korea market experts lowered target to 9,000 from 12,000 - Explained
items.summary: Goldman Sachs cut its 12-month KOSPI target by 25%, to 9,000 from 12,000, citing doubts about the AI trade and falling chip stocks. Despite the index’s steep decline and record-low valuations, the new target implies more than 60% upside.
